name: Mirror Desert Observatory
description: A mirrored observatory in a desert reflecting stars and dunes into infinity.
prompt: A single breathtaking architectural image: a low circular observatory in a vast desert, its exterior entirely mirrored, reflecting the Milky Way and rolling dunes, open central courtyard with a telescope, warm lanterns, indigo night sky, soft sand ripples, endless reflections, minimalist and majestic, ultra-detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: A building that borrows the sky. 🌌🪞
